waypoints.name: Torre

waypoints.name: Manteigas

sections.advice: Covilha → Torre climbs about 1993 m in 13 km. This is the part worth slowing down for - look through the bends and use the pull-offs.
Torre → Manteigas drops about 1993 m over 14 km. Brakes and eyes forward; the views are behind the corners, not in them.
Manteigas → Gouveia is 14 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.

scenicChapters.title: Serra da Estrela Road
scenicChapters.narrative: The last of the trees go and the road runs out onto open ground. The summit sits at 1993 m, and what surrounds it is rock, weather and distance — cold comes early up here and stays late. Ride it with something in reserve: the summit is not the end of the work, only the middle of it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Serra da Estrela Road
scenicChapters.narrative: For 22 km this is Serra da Estrela Road, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it. Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.

serra-da-estrela-road.story: 64 km one way from Covilhã - plan on about 1 h 05 of riding. The stops in between: Torre and Manteigas. The highest point is about 2,000 m. It suits an unhurried touring pace.

scenicChapters.title: Fertö / Neusiedlersee Cultural Landscape → Frontiers of the Roman Empi
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 61 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

places-ferto-neusiedlersee-cultural-land.story: From Mörbisch am See it runs 395 km to Mörbisch am See; allow about 6 h 49 of riding. The stops in between: Frontiers of the Roman Empire - The Danube, Wien - Legionslager Zentralbereich, Tulln - Kastell Zentralbereich and Mautern - Kastell Ostbereich. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.
